content:
Sara Gomez: customer on Dedicated reports SSE streams cutting out after ~40-70s when going through Cloudflare + ALB + nginx ingress. Direct-to-origin works fine. They see abrupt EOF, no final event. Ticket P1, customer blocked.

Josh Patel: do we have a request id or trace to correlate? any errors in runtime logs?

Sara Gomez: request-id in headers is req_9f2a7b. Runtime shows continuous keepalive comments and periodic data events; last write on runtime for this stream is successful. Upstream (nginx) logs show connection closed after a short gap. ALB access logs include a 504 around the same time.

Eli Tan: common pattern: intermediate proxies coalesce tiny chunks and ALB/CF idle timers then consider the connection idle. Cloudflare can buffer/hold small writes when converting between HTTP/2 and HTTP/1. ALB default idle timeout is 60s. If origin only sends small ":comment\n" lines, some proxies won't flush to client promptly.

Marta Ruiz: checklist to inspect: ALB idle_timeout, Cloudflare proxy buffering, nginx ingress settings (proxy_buffering, proxy_http_version), any Envoy sidecar route/idle timeouts, client reconnect auth/token behavior and Last-Event-ID handling.

Sara Gomez: quick repro I used locally:
1) simple SSE server that sends a comment every 25s and a data event every 12s.
2) route through Cloudflare dev mode -> ALB with default 60s -> k8s nginx ingress.
3) client: curl --no-buffer -v "https://cf.example.com/events?token=..." -H "Accept: text/event-stream"

Observed: stream starts, a couple events, then silent connection close ~50-65s. Direct to origin: stays open for >10m.

Josh Patel: useful debug steps:
- curl --no-buffer -v --header "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://.../stream"
- curl -v --http1.1 --no-keepalive ...  # force HTTP/1.1 to avoid HTTP/2 buffering
- tcpdump on origin edge to confirm packets leave origin

Eli Tan: nginx ingress recommended settings (examples):
```
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_read_timeout 300s;
proxy_send_timeout 300s;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```
Also response header `X-Accel-Buffering: no` helps with some nginx builds.

Marta Ruiz: Envoy notes if present: ensure `route_idle_timeout` is disabled or greater than expected stream length; set cluster tcp_keepalive and tune connection pool settings.

Sara Gomez: Cloudflare specifics:
- CF can buffer small writes; not all plans expose an "unbuffered streaming" option.
- CF has edge-level timeouts and can reassemble frames when translating HTTP/2 <-> HTTP/1.1.
- Workaround: send larger periodic flushes (e.g., ~1KB comment) so CF/ALB see bytes and won't treat connection as idle.

Josh Patel: headers to validate:
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Cache-Control: no-cache
Connection: keep-alive
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Accel-Buffering: no
Ensure server is flushing after writes (fflush or equivalent).

Sara Gomez: customer also saw missing events on reconnect. Root cause: client wasn't using Last-Event-ID on reconnects and origin didn't persist a recent-event window. Recommend supporting `id:` on events and letting clients re-request with `Last-Event-ID` header. Server should keep a small sliding buffer for dedupe.

Marta Ruiz: auth gotcha: short-lived tokens that expire between disconnect and reconnect cause 401s during rejoin. If client immediately retries but token rotation is delayed, sessions never recover. Recommend using refresh tokens or allowing a short grace window for streaming reconnects.

Eli Tan: short-term mitigations we suggested to customer:
1) Increase ALB idle timeout to 300s (if controllable).
2) Apply nginx ingress config above (proxy_buffering off, proxy_read_timeout/send_timeout 300s, proxy_http_version 1.1).
3) Emit a larger keepalive (1KB comment) every 20s to defeat buffering.
4) Implement `id:` on events + Last-Event-ID resume logic.
5) Temporarily bypass Cloudflare to confirm root cause.

Sara Gomez: customer applied #1 and #2; stability improved in their smoke tests. They still want written KB with repro steps / snippet. I'll draft.

Josh Patel: long-term platform ideas: auto-batch runtime keepalives into >1KB flushes for SSE endpoints, or add a per-route `streaming_flush_size` knob. Also surface recommended LB timeout values in Console onboarding and SRE docs.

Eli Tan: extra curl variants to test chunk behavior:
- `curl --no-buffer -v --http1.1` to force 1.1 path
- `curl -N` (same as --no-buffer) to avoid libcurl buffering
- `openssl s_client -connect origin:443` then send a raw HTTP/1.1 GET to observe chunk boundaries

Marta Ruiz: logging tips: increase nginx `proxy_buffering` debug and enable `$upstream_response_time` and `$request_time` in access log to capture timing around last writes. Tail runtime stdout with level=debug; look for `write()` errors or EPIPE on fd.

Sara Gomez: actionable items:
- Sara: publish KB + include reproduce curl/python snippets (ETA EOD).
- Eli: prototype runtime keepalive chunk flag (POC) 103 (sync tomorrow).
- Josh: add streaming checklist to support-runbook.

Deploy Bot: runtime/keepalive-poc scheduled deploy at 2026-03-05T02:00Z. Will post results. :rocket:

Sara Gomez: customer accepted the mitigations for now. I'll keep ticket open until we confirm long-term fix. If anyone finds Cloudflare-specific headers/workers to force real-time passthrough, drop them here.

Eli Tan: I'll test a CF Worker that proxies the origin and sets `cache-control: no-transform` and streams raw bytes; will paste script if it proves helpful.

-- end of thread --
